description: ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr: coastal flood and storm surge hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The listing groups 25 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about coastal flood and storm surge hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Définition du trait de côte du littoral du département de la Manche (5; Ouvrages et travaux autorisés et mis en œuvre dans le Var pour lutter ; PPRN de la commune de Marsilly ( - erosion cotiere et ); Zone réglementée du PPRN de la commune de Esnandes ( - erosion cotiere. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
